blocks.text: NEW YORK — US air travel was expected to return to normal on Monday after three days of widespread disruption following an extraordinary no-takeoff order issued by US aviation authorities. The ground stop issued Friday afternoon was only the second time such a directive had been issued nationwide in the busy US airspace since planes were grounded following the 9/11 attacks, and was blamed by the Trump administration on a faulty upgrade to communications equipment. As of Sunday evening more than 55 US-related flights — those traveling within, into or out of the United States — scheduled for Monday were cancelled, […]...
